text:
elaine: Quick final pass on company-level goals doc — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/okrs/q3-draft. Can execs please review and react? Need alignment on commit vs stretch items by Friday EOD. TL;DR below.

micah: TL;DR?

elaine: Top commit: Redwood Optimize pilot — target: reduce token-cost per 1M tokens by 20% for target workloads.
Commit: Dedicated capacity for 2 pilot customers + 1 fallback slot.
Stretch: Private on-prem for regulated verticals (aim Q3 but depends on infra hire).
Risk: Legal needs SOC2 addendum + FedRAMP scoping (affects Private timeline).
Tradeoff suggestion: move one Dedicated onboarding to Q4 to protect SLA & latency.

jules: LGTM on Optimize and Dedicated commit. Question on rollout: do we have infra headcount? if not, keep Private as stretch.

ravi: Agree. We only have two infra hires in pipeline. Ops: can we hit Dedicated SLA with current team?

ops-bot: capacity-plan v2 uploaded: https://internal/boards/capacity-plan. ETA for infra hires: 6-8 weeks. Current Dedicated throughput tested at ~85% of target on p50 latency.

priya: Legal flag: need to sign off on data residency language for Private. @legal-bot can you confirm timeline?

legal-bot: SOC2 addendum draft ready Thurs. FedRAMP scoping requires external consultant — estimate 4-6 weeks once scoped.

sam: From product-ops: recommend moving one onboarding to Q4 — frees infra and reduces risk to commitments.

elaine: So decision point: Move Customer C onboarding to Q4? @micah @jules please confirm so I can lock the doc.

micah: Confirm. Move Customer C to Q4, keep Optimize and the 2 Dedicated customers as committed.

jules: Confirm as well. Minor nit: update metric for Optimize to 'token-cost per 1M tokens' instead of relative %.

ravi: Agree on metric change.

elaine: Noted. Action items: 1) I'll update metrics + final doc, 2) Priya to loop legal for SOC2 addendum, 3) Ops to start onboarding plan for two customers, 4) People Ops to expedite infra hire pipeline.

priya: On it — I'll schedule legal review and copy compliance.

ops-bot: Added action items to project board: https://boards.redwood.ai/projects/optimize-rollout.

sam: LGTM. Approve from exec side.

micah: :thumbsup: Approved from my side.

jules: :thumbsup: Approved.

legal-bot: Added reviewers: @law-sr @compliance. Will ping if we need external counsel for FedRAMP scoping.

elaine: Marking this draft as "accepted" in the doc. I'll post the final doc by Friday morning and ping everyone for any last-minute issues. Thanks all.
